nodes.title: Run an external adoption pilot and fresh conformance suite

body:
## Objective

Review, tag, and publish Backplane v0.1.0 only after the integrated release candidate satisfies its adoption contract.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Final review and branch-finishing workflow.
- Fresh integrated verification, release notes, version tag, and GitHub release publication.
- Accurate documentation of supported and unsupported surfaces.

### Out of Scope

- Adding unrelated features during release preparation.
- Publishing with unresolved native blockers or unknown conformance results.
- Claiming support beyond the verified v0.1.0 contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every blocking release issue is closed as completed with integration and fresh verification evidence.
- The integrated target is clean, reviewed, and passes the exact release verification commands.
- License, adopter documentation, compatibility baseline, and limitations are accurate.
- GitHub exposes the intended v0.1.0 tag and release.

## Verification Seams

- Re-fetch this issue and every native blocker immediately before release.
- Run the full project-owned verification suite on the integrated target and record zero failures.
- Verify the published tag resolves to the reviewed commit and the release assets and notes match it.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Design authority: approved v0.1 adoption and release contract.

Plan: not yet created.
